name: Namo Hanumate Tubhyam
meaning: A salutation to Hanuman, son of the wind and devoted servant of Rama.
note: The last line in the client list (“Shyamashya cha tey namaha”) could not be matched to a source; the text is held back until it is confirmed.
supplied:
Namo Hanumate Tubhyam,
Namo Maruta Sunave,
Namah Sri Rama Bhaktaya,
Shyamashya cha tey Namaha.
